SELECT c.id, c.title, c.total_quota, c.stock, c.enroll_start, c.enroll_end, c.status, (e.id IS NOT NULL) AS enrolled FROM course c LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON e.course_id = c.id AND e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.status = 1
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.status ASC, c.enroll_start ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (title, total_quota, stock, enroll_start, enroll_end, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{totalQuota}, #{stock}, #{enrollStart}, #{enrollEnd}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET title = #{dto.title}, total_quota = #{dto.totalQuota}, stock = #{dto.totalQuota}, enroll_start = #{dto.enrollStart}, enroll_end = #{dto.enrollEnd}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE course SET stock = stock - 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0 AND status = 1
UPDATE course SET stock = stock + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND stock < total_quota
UPDATE course SET status = 1, updated_at = now() WHERE status = 0 AND enroll_start <= now()
UPDATE course SET status = 2, updated_at = now() WHERE status = 1 AND enroll_end <= now()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM course WHERE status = 0 AND enroll_start <= now() + interval '5 minutes'
